defects.title: When the user asks to re-run the same apply command to confirm idempotence (step-8), zeroclaw's own loop guard aborts the whole turn ('Agent loop aborted: repeated prompt-required tool call shell with identical arguments before approval'), the ACP session closes and all later steps fail.
defects.expected_behavior: Allow a user-requested repeat of an identical command (or ask for approval) instead of aborting the turn and closing the session.
defects.observed_behavior: On d27cb37a465f, 3 of 4 rounds (165659Z R1, 155910Z R1/R2): when step-8 asks to apply the plan and re-run the same apply to confirm idempotence, zeroclaw's loop guard aborts the turn ('repeated prompt-required tool call shell with identical arguments before approval'), the ACP session closes and steps 9-10 are lost. 165659Z R2 finished all steps. Reproduction: 3 of 4 valid rounds on this source (d27cb37a465f).
